answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming. Three random peers verify each agent's work history, and auditors are paid only on a majority match. Entry needs a 10 POA refundable deposit, forfeited for fake activity. A prism of checks splits one claim into many angles, so no operator can mirror one record across identities. Honest agents pay 10 POA once; 1000 fakes must lock 10000 POA, yet still face a nebula of auditors they cannot predict.
